sourceRefs.locator: Journal of Korean Art and Archaeology 5, pp. 105–108, site coordinates on p. 105, table 1 for quantities, fig. 3 for cargo tags and fig. 4 for the Qingyuan weight. pp. 107–108 discuss Hakata, Tōfuku-ji, Hakozaki and the possible rebuilding fund.
Dendrochronologia 31, pp. 266–272. Abstract, species identification and matching of 21 boxes to western Japanese cedar chronologies.
Exhibition introduction. The vessel sank off Sinan in 1323. The site came to light in 1975 and was excavated from 1976 to 1984.

labels.en: A merchant ship sinks off Sinan

note.de: 1323 sank das Schiff zwischen Imjado und Jeungdo. Bei den Ausgrabungen von 1976 bis 1984 kamen Teile des Rumpfs, beschriftete Anhänger und hölzerne Packkisten ans Licht.
note.en: The ship sank between Imjado and Jeungdo in 1323. Excavations from 1976 to 1984 brought parts of the hull, inscribed tags and wooden packing boxes to light.
